## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle commentary by [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) Zhìyǐ (538–597, the founder of the Tiāntái 天台 school) is the Tiāntái-school reading of the *[Guān wú liàng shòu fó jīng T0365](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0071)*. The work integrates Pure Land contemplative practice with the Tiāntái-school *zhǐguān* (śamatha-vipaśyanā) framework.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (580 – 597) reflects [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) Zhìyǐ's mature scholarly period at the imperial Suí court and at Tiāntáishān 天台山.

The Taishō text (T1750) is established on the standard apparatus.
